title: Sacred or Synthetic? Evaluating LLM Reliability and Abstention for Religious Questions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy and abstention rates on Islamic rulings across four different Sunni schools of thought (Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i, and Hanbali) using zero-shot question answering.
Comparing model correctness, error rates, and abstention behavior on identical religious questions presented in both English and Arabic.
